title: Why Learning Chinese
simplified_paragraphs: 我的中国朋友喜欢问我：为什么要学汉语？因为我喜欢旅游，如果会说汉语，在中国旅行很方便。现在不会汉语也能在中国旅行，可是会汉语可以和中国人聊天，了解中国文化。我很喜欢中国，也想在中国工作。
traditional_paragraphs: 我的中國朋友喜歡問我：為什麼要學漢語？因為我喜歡旅遊，如果會說漢語，在中國旅行很方便。現在不會漢語也能在中國旅行，可是會漢語可以和中國人聊天，瞭解中國文化。我很喜歡中國，也想在中國工作。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ de Zhōng guó péng you xǐ huan wèn wǒ： wèi shén me yào xué Hàn yǔ？ yīn wèi wǒ xǐ huan lǚ yóu， rú guǒ huì shuō Hàn yǔ， zài Zhōng guó lǚ xíng hěn fāng biàn。 xiàn zài bù huì Hàn yǔ yě néng zài Zhōng guó lǚ xíng， kě shì huì Hàn yǔ kě yǐ hé Zhōng guó rén liáo tiān， liǎo jiě Zhōng guó wén huà hěn xǐ huan Zhōng guó， yě xiǎng zài Zhōng guó gōng zuò。
english_paragraphs: My Chinese friends often ask me, “Why are you learning Chinese?” Because I love traveling, and speaking Chinese makes it much easier to travel in China. These days, you can travel in China without knowing Chinese, but if you speak it, you can chat with Chinese people and learn about Chinese culture. I really like China, and I’d like to work there too.
english_full: My Chinese friends often ask me, “Why are you learning Chinese?” Because I love traveling, and speaking Chinese makes it much easier to travel in China. These days, you can travel in China without knowing Chinese, but if you speak it, you can chat with Chinese people and learn about Chinese culture. I really like China, and I’d like to work there too.
